title: Study-style filter ignored when a group is almost full
text:
A few beta testers who chose "exam cram" ended up in "quiet" groups. It seems that when a group has only one seat left, the matcher fills the seat by course and time overlap and skips the study-style check.

Tomas collected two examples from Westbrook testers. Should be a small fix in the scoring step of the matching service, plus a regression test with a nearly full group.
